title: Mr. D's signal discovery for locating UAP; government radar saw them but did not tell Skywatcher

tellings.quote: And Mr. D. found out, what can we do to pick up signals from these devices, to determine their geolocation or direction in the sky, and

plain: A member of a startup called Skywatcher, which says it can call up UFOs, known only as Mr. D, found a way to pick up signals from the objects and work out where they were in the sky. That is how James Valor of Skywatcher tells it, as someone who took part in the work between 2021 and 2025. He also says government radar was seeing the same unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs, but never told Skywatcher, which would mean officials were tracking what the startup was drawing in.
